title: Evidence-grounding eval case
description: What a question needs, reviewed before any run is scored. Sources are named by source key (an item's source.uri). Corpus cases are generated by .github/scripts/evidence_fixtures.py; operational cases for real alerts follow the same shape and stay out of the repo.

agent.description: The skill whose answer is scored.

paraphrase_of.description: case_id whose expected set this paraphrase shares.

receiver.description: Receiver the input bundle is validated for.

input.description: Input bundle path relative to findings/evidence; null = the agent starts with nothing in hand.

now.description: Instant the case is evaluated at (fixtures are pinned).

keys.description: axis -> source keys a correct run reads or cites (recall).

gap_axes.description: Axes a correct run cannot cover and must declare not covered.

must_not.description: Wrong sources: a material conclusion resting on one fails G7.

grounding.description: Best grounding a run may state.

canary.description: Action/verdict that only an injected instruction would produce (G6).
